title: Northern Illinois Transit Authority proposes first budget, capital spending plan
summary: With new state funding, the Chicago-area agency will focus on “frequent and reliable service, strong infrastructure and a system where people feel safe,” its acting president said.

title: Homeless population declined 6.3% in January point-in-time count, HUD says
summary: The historic decline is the second consecutive annual drop in homelessness following a record surge.

title: A better way to manage municipal capital improvement plans
summary: Cities can make better infrastructure decisions by treating capital improvement planning as a continuous discipline rather than a periodic exercise, a municipal water engineer writes.

title: 6 state housing policies were on the ballot. Here’s where they stand.
summary: California, Hawaiʻi and Rhode Island have new voter-approved housing bond policies, but proposed permitting and zoning changes in California and Massachusetts remain undecided.

title: Uber to have 700 robotaxis by year’s end
summary: The ride-hailing company plans to begin robotaxi service in San Francisco and Houston early next year. “We have relationships with the cities. We have operations in those markets,” its CEO said.

title: What the midterm results mean for multifamily housing
summary: Housing affordability is likely to remain a top priority for Congress as Democrats take control, experts said.

title: NYC pied-à-terre tax rollout can proceed, appeals court rules
summary: The decision reversed a lower court's ruling that the initial notices sent to homeowners were flawed.

title: Voters’ data center backlash puts cities in the spotlight, experts say
summary: Overwhelming voter opposition could spur new state-level regulations and push local officials to demand more from data center developers on infrastructure, utilities and community impacts.

title: AI-powered assistance moves into physical spaces with AI City product
summary: The kiosks offer personalized guidance and real-time assistance in on-site, a tech company says. In Santa Clara County, California, a mayor’s hologram is giving the answers.

title: The best US cities for bike, pedestrian travel: Streetlight Data
summary: The report analyzed bicycle and pedestrian miles traveled in 100 U.S. cities. It found that walking accounted for seven times more miles annually than biking.
